risks.risk: Model/fitment mismatch: 'M272' may be incorrect or may refer to an engine family rather than the exact transmission code; wrong gearbox will not bolt up or will have wrong control/gear ratios.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the transmission ID tag/label and/or stamped code on the casing (and the VIN/engine code of the donor car if available).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a non-verified used gearbox with possible fitment issues (worst case: not the correct unit for the buyer’s car).

risks.risk: Missing parts/sensors/solenoids: 'complete' may still be missing external sensors, valve body components, wiring connectors, or mounting hardware.
risks.proof: Photos of the full gearbox from all sides plus close-ups of sensor ports/connectors and the bellhousing face; include a checklist photo of included items.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst case: missing key sensors/parts).

risks.risk: Condition/working status unknown: internal wear, metal debris, leaks, or converter damage may exist even if it looks intact.
risks.proof: Video of the gearbox being tested (or at minimum: proof of recent removal with fluid condition, and a drain/inspection photo showing no heavy debris).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven to work (worst case: needs overhaul).

risks.risk: Torque converter compatibility: the converter shown may not match the exact transmission variant (stall speed/part number mismatch).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the torque converter part number and matching transmission code, ideally with both labels visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as converter compatibility unverified (worst case: converter mismatch).

Photos of all sensor/connector ports and the bellhousing face (showing what’s included).
Video proof of operation/testing (or proof of recent removal with fluid condition and no heavy debris).
Confirm the exact donor vehicle (make/model/year) and the buyer’s target vehicle (make/model/year/engine) for fitment.
